Gestion des absences : Assurer le suivi des absences, vacances, congés et certificats médicaux. Accompagnement RH : Être un point de contact privilégié pour les collaborateurs et répondre à leurs questions relatives aux différents sujets RH. Relations Écoles : Contribuer au développement et au suivi des partenariats avec les écoles hôtelières afin de renforcer notre attractivité auprès des futurs talents. Communication & Événements internes : Participer à la communication RH ainsi qu’à l’organisation des événements destinés aux collaborateurs. Projets RH & Expérience Collaborateur : Contribuer aux différents projets RH et proposer des initiatives visant à améliorer continuellement l’expérience collaborateur. Profil : Formation : Vous êtes diplômé(e) d’une école hôtelière (Bachelor ou équivalent) et avez complété votre parcours par une formation en Ressources Humaines . Expérience : Vous disposez d’une expérience d’au minimum 3 ans dans une fonction RH similaire , obligatoirement acquise dans le secteur de l’hôtellerie-restauration . Paie : Vous maîtrisez les processus de paie, le suivi des temps de travail et la gestion des éléments variables de salaire. Connaissances RH : Vous disposez idéalement de bonnes connaissances du droit du travail suisse et des assurances sociales . Outils : Vous êtes à l’aise avec les outils informatiques et les systèmes d’information RH. Organisation : Rigoureux(se) et organisé(e), vous savez gérer plusieurs priorités simultanément et assurer un suivi précis de vos dossiers. Relationnel : Vous appréciez le contact humain et savez instaurer une relation de confiance avec vos interlocuteurs, tout en respectant la stricte confidentialité inhérente à la fonction RH. Posture : Autonome, dynamique et polyvalent(e), vous appréciez de travailler au sein d’une petite équipe où l’entraide, la réactivité et l’autonomie sont essentielles. Langues : Vous maîtrisez parfaitement le français, à l’oral comme à l’écrit . La maîtrise de l’anglais constitue un réel atout. Personnalité : Vous êtes force de proposition, orienté(e) solutions et aimez contribuer à une ambiance de travail positive. Pourquoi rejoindre la Maison Beau-Rivage ? Une fonction RH polyvalente et proche du terrain , au cœur de la vie de la Maison. L’opportunité d’accompagner les collaborateurs à chaque étape de leur parcours. Une participation active à la transformation d’un établissement emblématique en pleine rénovation. Des missions variées associant administration RH, paie, recrutement, relations écoles et expérience collaborateur . Un environnement de travail stimulant et exigeant au cœur de Genève. La possibilité de contribuer concrètement aux projets RH qui accompagneront le nouveau chapitre de Beau-Rivage. Rejoignez Beau-Rivage et contribuez à faire vivre une expérience collaborateur à la hauteur de l’excellence de notre Maison. Nos offres d’emploi s’adressent autant aux femmes qu’aux hommes. title: ML Intern: Optimization Quality & Monitoring
description: Our common vision Our mission is to help marketing teams unlock their full growth potential with AI. Our AI-powered attribution creates real transparency, showing how digital advertising investments perform across channels. On that foundation, we optimize budgets so our customers can sustainably grow their bottom line. We support leading European brands across e-commerce, telco, banking, insurance & energy, and many other industries in making their marketing smarter, more efficient, and more impactful. About the role Nexoya runs fully automated, AI-driven budget optimizations and simulations for enterprise marketing portfolios across many ad channels. Every result that reaches a customer must be correct, explainable and on time. As our ML Intern, you make sure it is: you monitor pipeline health, check the quality of predictions, optimizations and simulations, investigate anomalies and turn recurring manual checks into reliable tooling. You work closely with our ML engineers and Customer Success, and you see directly how your work shapes our customers' budget decisions. Your responsibilities Monitor the automation and assure result quality Monitor the automated prediction, optimization and simulation pipelines across customer portfolios and track run health, completeness and timeliness. Verify that predictions, optimization proposals and simulation results meet our quality standards before they reach customers: budget shifts, expected KPI changes, channel constraints and funnel-level effects. Investigate failed or unexpected runs, identify the root cause (data, configuration or model) and resolve it or escalate it with a clear diagnosis. Assure the quality of results over time Define and maintain plausibility checks for optimization and simulation results, for example for budget planning, seasonal shifts or new channel tests. Make sure results are consistent and explainable, so that customers and account managers can trust them without manual checks. Compare optimized and simulated outcomes with realized performance, document deviations and feed the findings back to the ML team. Safeguard data and model quality Monitor input data for gaps, anomalies and tracking changes that affect optimization quality. Track model fit and prediction accuracy per portfolio and flag degradation early. Maintain portfolio configurations such as funnel steps, constraints and target definitions together with the responsible teams. Automate the operational workflow Replace manual checks with Python scripts, validation rules and alerts. Build and maintain dashboards that show run status, data health and model performance across portfolios. Write runbooks so that operational knowledge is shared, not held by one person. The impact you will have Customers receive optimization proposals and simulations that are correct and delivered on time. Issues are caught before customers see them, not after. The time the ML team spends on operational work goes down measurably, because recurring steps are automated. Customer Success can trust automated optimization and simulation results without checking them by hand. Your experience and skills Recently completed Master's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering or a related field. Solid Python skills, including pandas and NumPy, and comfort working with SQL. Good understanding of statistics and basic machine learning concepts such as regression, model evaluation and overfitting. A careful, structured way of working: you check results before you share them and you document what you do. Ability to explain technical findings clearly to non-technical colleagues. Fluent English, spoken and written, is a must. Bonus points Experience with optimization methods, for example constrained or non-convex optimization. Familiarity with Marketing Mix Modeling, attribution or digital advertising metrics. Experience with data pipelines, scheduled jobs or monitoring tools. Experience with Git, Docker and cloud environments. Fluent in German or Italian. Your future work life Purpose: Your work directly influences how enterprise marketers allocate their budgets. Responsibility: You own the quality of a defined part of our automation from day one, with a personal development roadmap and regular feedback. Learning: You work alongside experienced ML and data engineers on production systems, not on side projects. Culture: A transparent company culture at eye level, where every person is valued and supported. Strategy: You take part in shaping company strategy and culture during our quarterly Strategy Days. Events: Regular team events, on-site and off-site. On that foundation, we optimize budgets so our customers can sustainably grow their bottom line. We support leading European brands across e-commerce, telco, banking, insurance & energy, and many other industries in making their marketing smarter, more efficient, and more impactful.

About the role

Nexoya runs fully automated, AI-driven budget optimizations and simulations for enterprise marketing portfolios across many ad channels. Every result that reaches a customer must be correct, explainable and on time. As our ML Intern, you make sure it is: you monitor pipeline health, check the quality of predictions, optimizations and simulations, investigate anomalies and turn recurring manual checks into reliable tooling. You work closely with our ML engineers and Customer Success, and you see directly how your work shapes our customers' budget decisions.

Your responsibilities

Monitor the automation and assure result quality

  • Monitor the automated prediction, optimization and simulation pipelines across customer portfolios and track run health, completeness and timeliness.

  • Verify that predictions, optimization proposals and simulation results meet our quality standards before they reach customers: budget shifts, expected KPI changes, channel constraints and funnel-level effects.

  • Investigate failed or unexpected runs, identify the root cause (data, configuration or model) and resolve it or escalate it with a clear diagnosis.

Assure the quality of results over time

  • Define and maintain plausibility checks for optimization and simulation results, for example for budget planning, seasonal shifts or new channel tests.

  • Make sure results are consistent and explainable, so that customers and account managers can trust them without manual checks.

  • Compare optimized and simulated outcomes with realized performance, document deviations and feed the findings back to the ML team.

Safeguard data and model quality

  • Monitor input data for gaps, anomalies and tracking changes that affect optimization quality.

  • Track model fit and prediction accuracy per portfolio and flag degradation early.

  • Maintain portfolio configurations such as funnel steps, constraints and target definitions together with the responsible teams.

Automate the operational workflow

  • Replace manual checks with Python scripts, validation rules and alerts.

  • Build and maintain dashboards that show run status, data health and model performance across portfolios.

  • Write runbooks so that operational knowledge is shared, not held by one person.

The impact you will have

  • Customers receive optimization proposals and simulations that are correct and delivered on time.

  • Issues are caught before customers see them, not after.

  • The time the ML team spends on operational work goes down measurably, because recurring steps are automated.

  • Customer Success can trust automated optimization and simulation results without checking them by hand.

Your experience and skills

  • Recently completed Master's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering or a related field.

  • Solid Python skills, including pandas and NumPy, and comfort working with SQL.

  • Good understanding of statistics and basic machine learning concepts such as regression, model evaluation and overfitting.

  • A careful, structured way of working: you check results before you share them and you document what you do.

  • Ability to explain technical findings clearly to non-technical colleagues.

  • Fluent English, spoken and written, is a must.

Bonus points

  • Experience with optimization methods, for example constrained or non-convex optimization.

  • Familiarity with Marketing Mix Modeling, attribution or digital advertising metrics.

  • Experience with data pipelines, scheduled jobs or monitoring tools.

  • Experience with Git, Docker and cloud environments.

  • Fluent in German or Italian.

Your future work life

  • Purpose: Your work directly influences how enterprise marketers allocate their budgets.

  • Responsibility: You own the quality of a defined part of our automation from day one, with a personal development roadmap and regular feedback.

  • Learning: You work alongside experienced ML and data engineers on production systems, not on side projects.

  • Culture: A transparent company culture at eye level, where every person is valued and supported.

  • Strategy: You take part in shaping company strategy and culture during our quarterly Strategy Days.

  • Events: Regular team events, on-site and off-site.

Application process

  • Profile review and short phone screen

  • Take-home case study

  • Case discussion with the ML team

  • On-site interview and team evaluation

title: ICT System Engineer & Developer 80-100 %
description: Du liebst die Abwechslung und willst Dich nicht zwischen Systembetrieb und Softwareentwicklung entscheiden müssen? Bei uns kannst Du beides! Wir suchen eine strukturierte Persönlichkeit, die unsere IT-Infrastruktur im Griff hat und gleichzeitig neue Softwarelösungen mitgestaltet. Wir wachsen und verstärken deshalb unser vierköpfiges ICT-Team per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung mit einem neuen Teammitglied im Pensum von 80 bis 100 %. Gemeinsam betreuen wir die IT unserer Firmengruppe mit mehreren Mandanten, mit über 100 Benutzerinnen und Benutzern an mehreren Standorten. Ob Dein Fundament in der Systemtechnik oder in der Applikationsentwicklung liegt: Wenn Du für moderne Technologien brennst, wollen wir Dich im Team haben. Aufgaben ICT Operation & Netzwerke Du stellst den stabilen Betrieb der IT-Umgebungen unserer gesamten Firmengruppe sicher, insbesondere Windows Server und Clients, Virtualisierung sowie Managed Security Services. Du betreust unsere Microsoft SQL Server und die dazugehörigen Datenbanken und sorgst für deren Verfügbarkeit und Performance. Du betreust unser internes Netzwerk, überwachst es aktiv und schützt unsere Netzwerkinfrastruktur mit geeigneten Tools und Firewalls. Du überwachst den operativen Betrieb proaktiv mit modernen Monitoring-Tools und behebst Störungen frühzeitig. Du verwaltest selbstständig die Benutzerberechtigungen im Active Directory und in Microsoft 365 und betreust gemeinsam mit unserem Partner unsere 3CX-Telefonielösung. Software & Innovation Du unterstützt das Team bei der Entwicklung, Implementierung und Wartung unserer internen Applikationen und Schnittstellen. Du nimmst Anforderungen aus den Fachabteilungen auf und setzt sie in pragmatische technische Lösungen um. Du testest moderne KI-Tools und integrierst sie, um interne Prozesse einfacher und effizienter zu gestalten. Support & Teamwork Du arbeitest im First- und Second-Level-Support mit und beantwortest die Fragen unserer Mitarbeitenden kompetent und hilfsbereit. Qualifikation Eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Informatikerin oder Informatiker EFZ mit Schwerpunkt Systemtechnik oder Applikationsentwicklung oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit fundierter Berufserfahrung. Fundierte Erfahrung im Betrieb von Windows Server- und Client-Umgebungen. Kenntnisse in Proxmox VE (PVE) sind ein Plus. Ein gutes Grundverständnis für Netzwerke und Firewalls sowie ein ausgeprägtes Sicherheitsbewusstsein. Erste Erfahrungen in der Softwareentwicklung mit C# im .NET-Umfeld und JavaScript sowie Freude daran, dieses Wissen zu vertiefen. Routine mit PowerShell oder anderen Skriptsprachen, um Aufgaben und administrative Prozesse zu automatisieren. Eine selbstständige, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise. Du packst Aufgaben proaktiv an. Grosses Interesse an neuen Technologien und Lust, das Potenzial von KI-Tools im Arbeitsalltag auszuloten. Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sowie gute Englischkenntnisse zum Verstehen von Fachliteratur und Dokumentationen. Benefits Eine abwechslungsreiche Generalistenrolle mit echtem Gestaltungsspielraum in einem wachsenden Unternehmen. Ein kleines, kollegiales Team mit kurzen Wegen und schnellen Entscheiden. Eine pragmatische Kultur, in der neugierige Ideen willkommen sind und KI-Tools aktiv eingesetzt werden. 5 Wochen Ferien. Jedes dritte Jahr eine zusätzliche Ferienwoche oder deren Auszahlung. Zeiterfassung mit der Möglichkeit, Überstunden zu kompensieren oder auszahlen zu lassen. Die Möglichkeit für Homeoffice. Interessiert? Dann freuen wir uns auf Deine Bewerbung! Rooted in 18 years of research at the Swiss Center for Electronics and Microtechnology (CSEM), our device is the world's only medically accurate, cuffless, continuous blood pressure monitor for daily use — clinically validated and CE Marked as a Class IIa medical device, now available in 12 countries. Role overview As Performance Marketing Manager – Paid Social , you will own Hilo’s paid social strategy and performance across our key markets and prepare the channel for Hilo’s next stage of growth. Creative strategy is a core driver of paid social performance: You turn customer insight and campaign data into compelling concepts, run a rigorous testing program and work with creative partners to bring the strongest ideas to market. You connect that work to measurable business outcomes, improving conversion and return on investment while making sure every health claim is accurate and approved. Reporting to the Head of Performance Marketing, you will play a key role in our performance marketing team, working with internal teams and external partners to drive growth. Work location: Our company operates on a remote-first model. This role can be performed remotely from anywhere in Europe. Fluent English and German are a must. Core responsibilities Lead paid social strategy, planning and execution across the US, UK, Germany and other growth markets. Develop creative hypotheses based on customer research, market differences and performance data. Brief, test and refine ad concepts, messages, formats and landing pages in partnership with creative and product teams. Manage campaign budgets, audiences and optimisation across Meta, TikTok and other relevant platforms. Identify opportunities to improve the customer journey and conversion rate, from ad click through to purchase. Measure performance against acquisition cost, revenue and return on investment and turn findings into clear decisions and next steps. Work with clinical, regulatory and legal colleagues to ensure advertising claims and health messaging are accurate and approved. Steer agencies and freelancers, set clear priorities and ensure high-quality execution and continuous performance improvement. Requirements Background & Experience At least 5 years of hands-on paid social experience in an international setting, including direct ownership of campaigns and budgets. Strong creative strategy skills and a track record of turning insights into ads that perform. A data-driven approach to testing, measurement, and decision-making. Experience improving conversion rates and managing campaigns against ROI goals. Deep knowledge of Meta Ads Manager and experience with other relevant social platforms. Nice to have: experience in health tech, medical devices, wearables, or subscription products. We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem . Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work. At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team. Visit www.perk.com to learn more. About the Team The Implementation team onboards our Premium, Pro and Enterprise customers onto the Perk platform, guiding them from signup to launch. We provide consultative, administrative, technical and educational support, and recommend ways to optimise each client's experience. About the Role The Senior Implementation Specialist is a change management and consultative expert who owns the onboarding and successful adoption of our Enterprise clients. You dig deep into client needs, define the best onboarding strategy, and lead change inside the customer's organisation. You bridge platform capabilities and client expectations, delivering a 7-star experience from first contact through long-term success. You ensure new clients are fully prepared to book business travel on Perk: configuring accounts to their requirements, supporting integrations and troubleshooting, and getting users ready through tailored training. You are confident steering clients towards the recommendations that serve them best in the long term, even when these differ from their original request. Technical expertise is central to the role. You are the in-depth expert on the Perk Travel platform and its configuration options, and you understand integrations and open APIs well enough to guide clients and their IT teams through marketplace partner and custom-built setups. You can troubleshoot issues, translate complex technical concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences, and recommend the most effective mix of automations, integrations and platform features for each client. You also learn new tools and concepts quickly as the product evolves. You are also a mentor for the Implementation team and the wider Revenue organisation, trusted as a source of expertise both internally and externally. Responsibilities Be the first impression of Perk and the first point of contact for clients and escalations throughout implementation, always delivering 7-star service. Hold consultative conversations to gather client requirements, and answer them with experience and data-driven best-practice recommendations. Act as the subject matter expert in change management and adoption, leading customers through introducing a new travel tool and policies, and providing guides, templates and recommendations to support long-term success. Act as a technical solutions expert: identify the best solutions for each client's needs, prioritising automations, integrations and the full range of platform functionality. Plan and deliver tailored training sessions for newly onboarded customers, including executive-level stakeholders and company-wide training. Lead cross-functional projects, keeping all internal stakeholders aligned on the goal of full customer ramp-up. Collaborate with Sales, Account Management, Product, Engineering and Finance. Prioritise accounts based on client and business needs. Simplify complex technical information for all audiences. Support Pre-Sales by explaining what an implementation will look like and how the platform can meet prospects' needs. Validate configuration and account satisfaction by monitoring client booking behaviour after launch, and proactively offering support or recommendations. Review completed implementations to improve your own process and the team's, following a cycle of execute, assess, improve, repeat. Mentor colleagues and set an example for the Implementation team and the wider Revenue organisation. What we look for A customer-first mindset, focused on a smooth onboarding and on what clients need to be happy in the long term. A proven track record as a high achiever in an Implementation Specialist role, with previous experience working with Enterprise clients. Success managing and delivering complex, international projects in a fast-paced environment, including defining scope and handling changing requirements while keeping the project on course. Demonstrated ability to work with C-level stakeholders to clarify their requirements and concerns clearly and professionally. Superb communication skills, and the ability to build relationships at all levels internally and externally, adapting your approach as needed. A thoughtful, consultative approach to making recommendations to clients and internal stakeholders. Organised, structured and analytical, with strong problem-solving skills, creativity in solutions and keen attention to detail. Tech-savvy, with an understanding of basic technical concepts around integrations and open APIs, and the ability to learn and adapt quickly. A solution-oriented, proactive mindset with a commitment to continuous improvement, spotting opportunities to improve things for clients and the team. Excitement for challenges and a personal drive to make a difference. AI at Perk AI is embedded in how we work across every function. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes. How We Work At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

About the Team

The Implementation team onboards our Premium, Pro and Enterprise customers onto the Perk platform, guiding them from signup to launch. We provide consultative, administrative, technical and educational support, and recommend ways to optimise each client's experience.


About the Role

The Senior Implementation Specialist is a change management and consultative expert who owns the onboarding and successful adoption of our Enterprise clients. You dig deep into client needs, define the best onboarding strategy, and lead change inside the customer's organisation. You bridge platform capabilities and client expectations, delivering a 7-star experience from first contact through long-term success.

You ensure new clients are fully prepared to book business travel on Perk: configuring accounts to their requirements, supporting integrations and troubleshooting, and getting users ready through tailored training. You are confident steering clients towards the recommendations that serve them best in the long term, even when these differ from their original request.

Technical expertise is central to the role. You are the in-depth expert on the Perk Travel platform and its configuration options, and you understand integrations and open APIs well enough to guide clients and their IT teams through marketplace partner and custom-built setups. You can troubleshoot issues, translate complex technical concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences, and recommend the most effective mix of automations, integrations and platform features for each client. You also learn new tools and concepts quickly as the product evolves.

You are also a mentor for the Implementation team and the wider Revenue organisation, trusted as a source of expertise both internally and externally.



Responsibilities

  • Be the first impression of Perk and the first point of contact for clients and escalations throughout implementation, always delivering 7-star service.

  • Hold consultative conversations to gather client requirements, and answer them with experience and data-driven best-practice recommendations.

  • Own the timeline, rollout plan and account while it is in implementation, preparing and executing onboarding plans with strong project management and directing work across the internal team.

  • Act as the subject matter expert in change management and adoption, leading customers through introducing a new travel tool and policies, and providing guides, templates and recommendations to support long-term success.

  • Act as a technical solutions expert: identify the best solutions for each client's needs, prioritising automations, integrations and the full range of platform functionality.

  • Configure client accounts to their specifications and provide technical support and troubleshooting, including setting up integrations with marketplace partners or custom-built API solutions.

  • Plan and deliver tailored training sessions for newly onboarded customers, including executive-level stakeholders and company-wide training.

  • Lead cross-functional projects, keeping all internal stakeholders aligned on the goal of full customer ramp-up. Collaborate with Sales, Account Management, Product, Engineering and Finance.

  • Prioritise accounts based on client and business needs.

  • Simplify complex technical information for all audiences.

  • Support Pre-Sales by explaining what an implementation will look like and how the platform can meet prospects' needs.

  • Validate configuration and account satisfaction by monitoring client booking behaviour after launch, and proactively offering support or recommendations.

  • Review completed implementations to improve your own process and the team's, following a cycle of execute, assess, improve, repeat.

  • Mentor colleagues and set an example for the Implementation team and the wider Revenue organisation.


What we look for

  • A customer-first mindset, focused on a smooth onboarding and on what clients need to be happy in the long term.

  • A proven track record as a high achiever in an Implementation Specialist role, with previous experience working with Enterprise clients.

  • Success managing and delivering complex, international projects in a fast-paced environment, including defining scope and handling changing requirements while keeping the project on course.

  • Demonstrated ability to work with C-level stakeholders to clarify their requirements and concerns clearly and professionally.

  • Superb communication skills, and the ability to build relationships at all levels internally and externally, adapting your approach as needed.

  • A thoughtful, consultative approach to making recommendations to clients and internal stakeholders.

  • Organised, structured and analytical, with strong problem-solving skills, creativity in solutions and keen attention to detail.

  • Tech-savvy, with an understanding of basic technical concepts around integrations and open APIs, and the ability to learn and adapt quickly.

  • A solution-oriented, proactive mindset with a commitment to continuous improvement, spotting opportunities to improve things for clients and the team.

  • Excitement for challenges and a personal drive to make a difference.

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

This is an AI-enabled role: you'll use AI tooling to generate test cases, speed up bug reproduction, and write automation scripts, so you spend more time on the hard problems and less on repetition. Key Responsibilities Own release QA: build test plans and regression suites, and make the go/no-go call for every release. Validate our critical flows end to end: onboarding, paywalls, checkout, payments, and subscription state transitions. Reproduce and document bugs clearly, coordinate fixes with engineering, and verify resolutions before they ship. Grow our automation coverage: automate repetitive tests, maintain release checklists, and drive down escaped defects. Classify bug severity and set the escalation path within QA's scope. Document QA processes and playbooks in Confluence so quality practices scale with the team. Use AI-enabled tooling to accelerate test coverage, bug reproduction, and scripting. Job requirements What We're Looking For You are structured but pragmatic. Must-haves: 3+ years of experience in QA or test engineering for web and/or mobile products. Experience building automated UI tests with Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or similar, in JavaScript/TypeScript. Able to investigate unstable runs, fix flaky tests, and tell a broken test from a broken product. Experience testing mobile applications (including Flutter) and web applications in browsers and in-app browsers, using real device clouds such as BrowserStack or LambdaTest. Comfortable working with APIs and verifying behaviour through data: REST and GraphQL, querying services and admin tools, and checking analytics events. Strong bug reporting skills: clear reproduction steps, severity assessment, and root-cause thinking. Comfortable making and defending release readiness decisions with engineering and product stakeholders; experience in cross-functional teams with frequent releases. Professional working proficiency in English, written and spoken. Nice-to-haves: Analytics and event verification: Mixpanel, Klaviyo, Google Analytics, Meta Pixel. You'll own the outcome: Figuring out where Talk360's next valuable user is and the smartest way to reach them, across Google, Meta, TikTok, SEO, app stores, AI search, and whatever comes next. Think investment manager for acquisition, not channel specialist. Talk360 has been profitably growing since 2025. We're a lean team of around 30 people, with the majority of team working from the Amsterdam office. We're looking for someone genuinely channel agnostic: you don't wake up thinking about Google Ads or SEO; you wake up thinking about where the next valuable Talk360 user is. What you’ll do Own the acquisition portfolio: Continuously evaluate and reallocate investment across paid channels (Google Ads, Apple Search Ads, Meta, TikTok) and organic channels (SEO, ASO, content), based on where the next euro or hour of effort returns the most. Run segment-led acquisition: Adapt proposition, creative, keywords, landing pages, and app store presence for our three core segments, Calling Home, Calling for Work, and Calling When It Counts, and learn which segment performs best in which channel, market, and corridor. Connect acquisition to LTV: Track performance past the click or install, through registration, first purchase, calling behaviour, and retention, so decisions get made on CAC and LTV together, not platform ROAS alone. Build our AI discovery presence: Develop Talk360's approach to discovery as more of our future users start their search inside AI tools instead of Google. Run a continuous experimentation pipeline: Turn acquisition hypotheses (a new high-intent search category, a different proposition, an underserved corridor, a new distribution channel) into small, fast tests, and turn the results into investment decisions. The Team You’ll join a lean Commercial team where acquisition, brand, product marketing, CRM, content and data work closely together. No big silos or layers of approval: You’ll work directly with product, data and creative to turn an insight into a live experiment quickly. What you’ll bring Strong experience running paid acquisition on Google Ads, Meta, and/or Apple Search Ads, with real budget ownership and results to show for it. Working knowledge of SEO and ASO, and a track record of building organic acquisition that compounds rather than resetting every quarter. Fluency in CAC, ROAS, conversion, ARPU, and LTV, and the ability to build one framework that lets you compare channels that have never been compared before. Comfort moving between data, creative, content, and technology to shorten the distance between an idea and a live experiment. Active, current use of AI in your own marketing workflow, for research, analysis, content variation, and speeding up execution, not just openness to using it. Who you are Channel agnostic and opportunity driven, you're motivated by finding the next valuable user, not by defending a particular channel or discipline. Comfortable moving investment away from something that isn't working anymore, even if you're the one who built it. Genuinely curious about how AI is reshaping search and discovery and energised by figuring out a playbook that doesn't exist yet rather than waiting for one. raw.title: Senior Acquisition Marketeer
raw.description:
The Challenge

Talk360 connects more than 6 million people across 190 countries. How they find us is changing fast: Search is moving from blue links to AI generated answers and paid and organic increasingly shape each other. A missed opportunity here isn't just a lower ROAS number. It's someone staying connected with family abroad, a business trying to reach a supplier, or someone who urgently needs to reach a real phone number.

As our Senior Acquisition Marketeer, you won't own a channel. You'll own the outcome: Figuring out where Talk360's next valuable user is and the smartest way to reach them, across Google, Meta, TikTok, SEO, app stores, AI search, and whatever comes next. Think investment manager for acquisition, not channel specialist.

Talk360 has been profitably growing since 2025. We're a lean team of around 30 people, with the majority of team working from the Amsterdam office. We're looking for someone genuinely channel agnostic: you don't wake up thinking about Google Ads or SEO; you wake up thinking about where the next valuable Talk360 user is.

What you’ll do

  • Own the acquisition portfolio: Continuously evaluate and reallocate investment across paid channels (Google Ads, Apple Search Ads, Meta, TikTok) and organic channels (SEO, ASO, content), based on where the next euro or hour of effort returns the most.

  • Run segment-led acquisition: Adapt proposition, creative, keywords, landing pages, and app store presence for our three core segments, Calling Home, Calling for Work, and Calling When It Counts, and learn which segment performs best in which channel, market, and corridor.

  • Connect acquisition to LTV: Track performance past the click or install, through registration, first purchase, calling behaviour, and retention, so decisions get made on CAC and LTV together, not platform ROAS alone.

  • Build our AI discovery presence: Develop Talk360's approach to discovery as more of our future users start their search inside AI tools instead of Google.

  • Run a continuous experimentation pipeline: Turn acquisition hypotheses (a new high-intent search category, a different proposition, an underserved corridor, a new distribution channel) into small, fast tests, and turn the results into investment decisions.

The Team

You’ll join a lean Commercial team where acquisition, brand, product marketing, CRM, content and data work closely together. No big silos or layers of approval: You’ll work directly with product, data and creative to turn an insight into a live experiment quickly.


What you’ll bring

  • Strong experience running paid acquisition on Google Ads, Meta, and/or Apple Search Ads, with real budget ownership and results to show for it.

  • Working knowledge of SEO and ASO, and a track record of building organic acquisition that compounds rather than resetting every quarter.

  • Fluency in CAC, ROAS, conversion, ARPU, and LTV, and the ability to build one framework that lets you compare channels that have never been compared before.

  • Comfort moving between data, creative, content, and technology to shorten the distance between an idea and a live experiment.

  • Active, current use of AI in your own marketing workflow, for research, analysis, content variation, and speeding up execution, not just openness to using it.


Who you are

  • Channel agnostic and opportunity driven, you're motivated by finding the next valuable user, not by defending a particular channel or discipline.

  • Comfortable moving investment away from something that isn't working anymore, even if you're the one who built it.

  • Genuinely curious about how AI is reshaping search and discovery and energised by figuring out a playbook that doesn't exist yet rather than waiting for one.

  • Analytical: You can find the meaningful signal inside a pile of noisy performance data and act on it.

  • Understand the limits of attribution and don't let an imperfect model stop you from making a call.

  • You’re able to come to our office in Amsterdam on Mondays, Wednesday and Thursdays

Recruitment process

  • First Call: a short call with our recruiter to get to know each other a bit better

  • Hiring Manager Interview: a deep dive into your experience with the Chief Revenue Officer

  • Case Study: visit of our office where you will present a practical task to our team

  • Meeting with the CEO

What you get

Competitive compensation

  • Senior Acquisition Marketeer salary: €80,000 – €90,000 gross per year (all-in)

Learning and growth

  •  €1,500 annual personal development budget, plus access to company-wide training sessions to keep learning and evolving.

Time to recharge

  • 25 vacation days

  • Option to swap two public holidays per year for days that better reflect your culture or beliefs

  • Recharge Fridays, unlocked when team targets are met (we'll tell you more during the interview)

Work from anywhere

  • As a global and diverse team, we encourage you to work from another city or country for up to 2 weeks per year, gain fresh perspectives and spark new ideas.

A team you'll actually want to be part of

  • Weekly team lunch every Thursday

  • Regular team moments and outings

  • An international and diverse team, with colleagues from the Netherlands, South Africa, Nigeria, Suriname, Turkey, Egypt, Kenya, Ukraine and beyond

Set up for success

  • Company laptop and all the tools you need to do your best work

  • Monthly phone allowance and commuting allowance

An environment to grow and make impact

  • A collaborative environment where you can learn from others, take ownership, and contribute to a meaningful mission.


About Talk360

Talk360 was founded with a clear purpose: to become the most accessible and reliable calling app for African diaspora communities, both within Africa and abroad. For our users, calls are not transactional, they are emotional lifelines to family, friends, and essential support networks. When service quality drops, they feel it immediately. That responsibility drives everything we build.

Over the past years, Talk360 has grown into a global communications platform connecting more than 6 million people worldwide last year. We successfully spun off our payments arm into NjiaPay, stepped into the gap left by the discontinuation of Skype, and achieved profitable growth from 2025 onwards, marking our transition from early-stage scale-up to a disciplined, sustainable business.

As we continue to grow, we are expanding beyond our own B2C app. We are now launching our first embedded calling products within partner platforms, bringing Talk360’s technology into new ecosystems and enabling partners to offer international calling directly within their own products.

Our ambition is bold: to become the world’s most trusted way to call any real phone number — connecting migrants, travellers, professionals, and businesses across the globe.

title: Lead Analytics Engineer
description: Do you love turning messy business questions into data people can trust? Can you connect the customer journey from the first marketing touch through sales conversion, revenue, retention, and product usage and explain the numbers equally clearly to an engineer, a CMO, and a CFO? AIHR is looking for a Lead Agentic Analytics Engineer to become the hands-on functional lead of our two-person Data & Analytics team. You will own the translation of cross-functional business questions into trusted metrics, governed semantic models, and decision-ready agentic analytics; set the analytical direction; and build the most critical models yourself. You are transforming raw data into governed products that drive decision-making for our business partners.   About AIHR Founded in 2016 with the mission to future-proof HR, the Academy to Innovate HR (AIHR) has become the global market leader in online training for HR professionals. We support customers in more than 140 countries, including organizations such as Unilever, Reckitt, Goldman Sachs, Philips, Deloitte, Nike, Heineken, and UBS. Our goal is to continuously upskill and empower one million HR professionals. Today, we are an international team of more than 100 people representing over 30 nationalities. We are driven by excellence, innovation, and a hunger to grow, while staying friendly, enthusiastic, and committed to helping each other succeed. Working at AIHR means taking real responsibility, improving how we operate, and getting the freedom to develop in new areas and shape your role as the company grows. Role and Responsibilities AIHR's Data & Analytics team is part of Business Operations. You will work alongside Vahid, our Senior Data Engineer, and report to Leo, our VP of Business Operations. Our ingestion and warehouse foundation is largely established: data from systems such as HubSpot and our own LMS moves through ETL pipelines into Snowflake. Through special Projects, we are building governed semantic layers on top so the business can self-serve trusted analytics through Power BI, Metabase, and AI tools. Your role owns the step that matters most: translating a business question into a clear definition, a well-designed model, and conversational/agentic analytics that your leadership trusts. You will set the analytical architecture, dbt standards, and roadmap, while Vahid focuses on ingestion, warehouse reliability, and engineering implementation. You will both build: you will personally deliver the most critical business models, review implementations, and ensure the outputs are usable by the business. This role has no direct reports. Your colleague, Vahid, remains managed by the VP of Business Operations, while you have clear functional decision rights over metric definitions, semantic-model design, analytical quality, dbt standards, and technical priorities. It is designed for someone who wants to lead through expertise while remaining close to the work.   What You'll Own Own and execute a rolling one-year Data & Analytics roadmap, balancing urgent business needs with foundational work. Guide Vahid through clear priorities, design reviews, code review, and reusable modeling patterns. Lead discovery across Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Finance to uncover the decision behind a request and translate it into agreed metric definitions, governed semantic layers, and data models that connect the full customer lifecycle. Set the analytical architecture and dbt standards; design, build, test, and document the most critical governed models yourself using SQL and dbt. Own the full-funnel measurement framework—from marketing reach, demand generation, attribution, and customer acquisition cost through lead and pipeline conversion, sales cycle, bookings, and revenue to onboarding, product adoption, expansion, renewal, churn, and customer lifetime value. Keep core recurring-revenue definitions finance-grade and reconciled while showing how upstream activity drives downstream customer outcomes. Own the logic and quality behind executive dashboards and self-service analytics across Power BI, Metabase, and AI-enabled interfaces. Present the results to senior leaders, explain every assumption, and respond constructively to challenge. Partner closely with Vahid on warehouse and pipeline requirements, resolve conflicting numbers at the source, and raise the technical quality of the team. Apply AI where it improves development speed or data access, while using sound judgment around privacy, governance, validation, and trust. A Typical Week This is a hands-on lead role. The exact balance will shift with business priorities, but you should expect roughly half your time to remain close to the data—building, reviewing, and investigating—and the rest to be split across discovery, functional leadership, and decision support. Design or improve a dbt model that connects data across HubSpot, our LMS, billing, or other source systems; write the SQL, tests, documentation, and metric logic needed to put it into production. Run discovery sessions with leaders in Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Product, or Finance to clarify the decision they need to make, challenge the requested metric, and agree on the definition. Work side by side with Vahid on source-data requirements, architecture choices, and implementation; review code and unblock delivery without handing off all of the technical work. Investigate a commercial or customer-lifecycle question, improve an executive or functional dashboard, and present the conclusion—including assumptions and limitations—to the relevant leadership team. Reprioritize the Data & Analytics roadmap, resolve competing requests, and invest in the semantic layer, governance, and reusable modeling foundations that reduce future ad hoc work. What Success Looks Like Within your first three months, you have established a clear operating model with Vahid, mapped ownership of the most important metrics, agreed the Data & Analytics roadmap, and resolved at least one material conflicting-number problem. Within six months, AIHR has a governed customer-lifecycle domain in dbt and an executive view connecting acquisition and pipeline to revenue, retention, and product usage, and has launched the first MVP of our agentic analytics platform to drive self-serve adoption. The underlying definitions are documented, reconciled where relevant, and trusted across Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Finance. Within twelve months, two or three priority business domains are governed end to end, leadership can trace performance from acquisition through lifetime value using consistent numbers, self-service adoption is growing, and Vahid can independently implement the modeling patterns and quality standards you established. Throughout, you remain hands-on in SQL, dbt, Snowflake, and analytics while setting direction, coaching through the work, and earning leadership's trust in both the numbers and the roadmap. We offer A high-impact role as the functional lead of a small Data & Analytics team, with end-to-end ownership of the semantic layer behind company-wide decisions. Competitive, benchmarked compensation. Substantial autonomy to shape your day-to-day work, with regular growth conversations and support for your career goals. Flexible working hours and work-from-home arrangements after onboarding. 26 paid holidays per year, plus one extra day for each of your first five years at AIHR. The option to exchange any two public holidays for two days of your choice. A work-from-anywhere policy that lets you work abroad for up to 20 days per calendar year. A pension plan, four Trust Days for ad hoc recovery, and access to the OpenUp mental health platform. A personal development budget, training opportunities, and the books you need to keep learning. All public-transport expenses covered through an NS Business Card, plus a MacBook and the equipment you need. A beautiful office opposite Rotterdam Central Station, a satellite office in Amsterdam, daily chef-prepared lunch, regular drinks, team activities, and free access to the office gym. Get a taste of working at AIHR in our AIHR Benefits Guide . Apply for the Job Are you excited to become our Lead Analytics Engineer? We would love to hear from you. We are aiming for a start date in December 2026 or January 2027. P.S. If this role excites you but you do not meet every point, we still encourage you to apply. We care about the evidence behind your experience and your potential to grow—not a perfect checklist. Who you are You are a hands-on technical leader: commercially sharp, calm under challenge, and confident enough to defend your numbers in any room. You also have the patience to build data foundations properly and raise the quality of the work around you. You bring 5+ years of experience across analytics engineering, BI, data engineering, or business-facing analytics roles, including substantial recent hands-on analytics engineering and evidence of leading work beyond your own delivery. You have a proven track record of building semantic layers or governed dimensional models end-to-end—from business discovery and metric definition to production models and adoption—not only dashboards. You have expert SQL and data modeling skills, strong production experience with dbt, and hands-on experience with Snowflake or a comparable warehouse, along with a BI tool such as Power BI, Looker, Omni, or Metabase. You bring strong financial acumen, but your analytical experience extends across the full customer lifecycle. You can connect marketing acquisition and attribution, sales pipeline and conversion, revenue and unit economics, customer retention and expansion, and product adoption into one coherent model. You understand how bookings, billings, recognized revenue, cash, ARR, and NRR differ without treating financial reporting as the whole analytical problem. You have worked in a B2B SaaS, subscription, fintech, or marketplace business and have modeled several stages of the funnel spanning marketing or growth, sales, customer success and retention, and product usage—rather than specializing in only one function. You explain complex logic in plain language, push back constructively on senior stakeholders, and build trust without becoming defensive—even when you discover that your own number or assumption needs to change. You take pride in driving the analytical roadmap and architectural vision, leading technical work through architecture and code review, and mentoring experienced colleagues without relying on formal authority. You want the majority of your role to remain hands-on. You balance pragmatic execution with rigorous analysis, adapting precision levels to fit business needs and operational constraints. You are used to leveraging a broad range of AI tools to boost your productivity and know how to configure them to produce output that lives up to our quality standards and best practices Nice to Have Earlier experience in RevOps, Growth, FP&A, product analytics, or commercial analytics, ideally combined with experience in a fast-growing scale-up. Experience with HubSpot, marketing automation and attribution data, subscription or billing data, LMS or product-usage event data, Personio, or building semantic layers for AI-enabled and conversational analytics. Through special Projects, we are building governed semantic layers on top so the business can self-serve trusted analytics through Power BI, Metabase, and AI tools.

Your role owns the step that matters most: translating a business question into a clear definition, a well-designed model, and conversational/agentic analytics that your leadership trusts. You will set the analytical architecture, dbt standards, and roadmap, while Vahid focuses on ingestion, warehouse reliability, and engineering implementation. You will both build: you will personally deliver the most critical business models, review implementations, and ensure the outputs are usable by the business.

This role has no direct reports. Your colleague, Vahid, remains managed by the VP of Business Operations, while you have clear functional decision rights over metric definitions, semantic-model design, analytical quality, dbt standards, and technical priorities. It is designed for someone who wants to lead through expertise while remaining close to the work.

 

What You'll Own

  • Own and execute a rolling one-year Data & Analytics roadmap, balancing urgent business needs with foundational work. Guide Vahid through clear priorities, design reviews, code review, and reusable modeling patterns.

  • Lead discovery across Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Finance to uncover the decision behind a request and translate it into agreed metric definitions, governed semantic layers, and data models that connect the full customer lifecycle.

  • Set the analytical architecture and dbt standards; design, build, test, and document the most critical governed models yourself using SQL and dbt.

  • Own the full-funnel measurement framework—from marketing reach, demand generation, attribution, and customer acquisition cost through lead and pipeline conversion, sales cycle, bookings, and revenue to onboarding, product adoption, expansion, renewal, churn, and customer lifetime value. Keep core recurring-revenue definitions finance-grade and reconciled while showing how upstream activity drives downstream customer outcomes.

  • Own the logic and quality behind executive dashboards and self-service analytics across Power BI, Metabase, and AI-enabled interfaces. Present the results to senior leaders, explain every assumption, and respond constructively to challenge.

  • Partner closely with Vahid on warehouse and pipeline requirements, resolve conflicting numbers at the source, and raise the technical quality of the team. Apply AI where it improves development speed or data access, while using sound judgment around privacy, governance, validation, and trust.

A Typical Week

This is a hands-on lead role. The exact balance will shift with business priorities, but you should expect roughly half your time to remain close to the data—building, reviewing, and investigating—and the rest to be split across discovery, functional leadership, and decision support.

  • Design or improve a dbt model that connects data across HubSpot, our LMS, billing, or other source systems; write the SQL, tests, documentation, and metric logic needed to put it into production.

  • Run discovery sessions with leaders in Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Product, or Finance to clarify the decision they need to make, challenge the requested metric, and agree on the definition.

  • Work side by side with Vahid on source-data requirements, architecture choices, and implementation; review code and unblock delivery without handing off all of the technical work.

  • Investigate a commercial or customer-lifecycle question, improve an executive or functional dashboard, and present the conclusion—including assumptions and limitations—to the relevant leadership team.

  • Reprioritize the Data & Analytics roadmap, resolve competing requests, and invest in the semantic layer, governance, and reusable modeling foundations that reduce future ad hoc work.

What Success Looks Like

Within your first three months, you have established a clear operating model with Vahid, mapped ownership of the most important metrics, agreed the Data & Analytics roadmap, and resolved at least one material conflicting-number problem.

Within six months, AIHR has a governed customer-lifecycle domain in dbt and an executive view connecting acquisition and pipeline to revenue, retention, and product usage, and has launched the first MVP of our agentic analytics platform to drive self-serve adoption. The underlying definitions are documented, reconciled where relevant, and trusted across Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Finance.

Within twelve months, two or three priority business domains are governed end to end, leadership can trace performance from acquisition through lifetime value using consistent numbers, self-service adoption is growing, and Vahid can independently implement the modeling patterns and quality standards you established.

Throughout, you remain hands-on in SQL, dbt, Snowflake, and analytics while setting direction, coaching through the work, and earning leadership's trust in both the numbers and the roadmap.

  • Competitive, benchmarked compensation.

  • Substantial autonomy to shape your day-to-day work, with regular growth conversations and support for your career goals.

  • Flexible working hours and work-from-home arrangements after onboarding.

  • 26 paid holidays per year, plus one extra day for each of your first five years at AIHR.

  • The option to exchange any two public holidays for two days of your choice.

  • A work-from-anywhere policy that lets you work abroad for up to 20 days per calendar year.

  • A pension plan, four Trust Days for ad hoc recovery, and access to the OpenUp mental health platform.

  • A personal development budget, training opportunities, and the books you need to keep learning.

P.S. If this role excites you but you do not meet every point, we still encourage you to apply. We care about the evidence behind your experience and your potential to grow—not a perfect checklist.


Who you are

You are a hands-on technical leader: commercially sharp, calm under challenge, and confident enough to defend your numbers in any room. You also have the patience to build data foundations properly and raise the quality of the work around you.

  • You bring 5+ years of experience across analytics engineering, BI, data engineering, or business-facing analytics roles, including substantial recent hands-on analytics engineering and evidence of leading work beyond your own delivery.

Both work, and both have far more potential than we currently capture. Your job is to optimize what we have, evolve it into a set of structured commercial partner programs, and work out which new channels deserve investment. This is a quota-carrying role with a build mandate. You manage a running book of business with our existing commercial partners and stay their main point of contact. We have a strong belief that these partners, HR implementation consultants in particular, are well placed to position our courses with their clients, and that this can become a major revenue stream for AIHR. title: Senior Quality Engineer
description: Ben jij een Senior Quality Engineer die verder kijkt dan het oplossen van afwijkingen? Iemand die kwaliteit ziet als een stuurinstrument en het voortouw neemt in structurele verbetering? Dan bieden wij jou een rol waarin je écht het verschil maakt. Als Senior Quality Engineer ben je een sleutelspeler in het naar een hoger volwassenheidsniveau brengen van onze kwaliteitsperformance. Je acteert proactief, signaleert risico’s vóórdat ze problemen worden en stuurt op duurzame oplossingen. Je bent geen volger van processen, maar mede‑vormgever van hoe kwaliteit wordt geborgd, verbeterd en beleefd wordt bij ons. Een belangrijk onderdeel van je rol is het inhoudelijk en methodisch leiden van verbetertrajecten, waaronder het aanjagen en begeleiden van het Quality Improvement Team (QIT‑proces). Je fungeert daarbij als coach, challenger en inhoudelijk geweten. Wat ga je, onder andere, doen? Proactief analyseren van kwaliteitsafwijkingen, trends en risico’s om structurele, systeemgedreven oorzaken bloot te leggen. Leiden van root cause analyses en borgen van effectieve, duurzame CAPA’s. Initiëren, ontwikkelen en borgen van kwaliteitsstandaarden, procedures en werkinstructies. Voorbereiden, uitvoeren en doelgericht benutten van interne en externe audits. Analyseren en vertalen van kwaliteits‑KPI’s naar concrete verbeteracties en besluitvorming. Regie voeren op kwaliteit binnen NPI‑projecten, inclusief kritische beoordeling van deliverables en klantspecificaties. Waar maak jij het verschil? Je werkt intensief samen met productie, engineering, supply chain en klanten, maar neemt vooral ook inhoudelijk leiderschap. raw.title: Senior Quality Systems Officer
raw.description:
About Vitestro

Founded in 2017 in Utrecht, Vitestro is pioneering the future of blood collection with the Aletta® Autonomous Robotic Phlebotomy Device™ (ARPD™). This groundbreaking medical device combines advanced multi-modal imaging (near-infrared, ultrasound, and Doppler ultrasound) with robotics and AI to perform the entire diagnostic blood draw procedure autonomously.

 

By addressing critical healthcare staffing shortages and improving patient experience, Vitestro is transforming one of the most common and essential medical procedures. With more than 130 team members and growing rapidly, we are scaling our impact. As we placed our first devices with customers, we are now expanding our team to ensure successful implementation and long-term reliability.

 

At Vitestro, we are committed to continuous innovation and improvement.

As our Senior QS officer, you focus on the continuous improvement of our quality systems and support the company through the change control process. You review existing quality processes, identify where they can be improved or made more compliant, and help develop practical solutions to make those improvements happen. 

You also guide colleagues through change control. Rather than executing every change yourself, you ensure people understand and follow the process, ask the right questions, consider the relevant implications, obtain the necessary approvals, and ensure that changes are completed Correctly and on time. 

This role requires a strong analytical and systematic mindset combined with a pragmatic approach to quality. You should be comfortable identifying problems, but more importantly, finding workable solutions and alternatives. You understand the requirements of working in a regulated environment without approaching quality as simply enforcing rules. You are able to adapt, think creatively and help the organisation find compliant ways forward.

First months at Vitestro

In your first months, you get to know Vitestro’s quality systems, processes, and the teams working with them. You build a thorough understanding of our Change Control process and start supporting colleagues through changes, helping them consider the right questions and ensuring changes are complete, appropriately approved, and progressing on time. As you become familiar with how we work, you identify opportunities to improve the compliance and efficiency of the Change Control process and develop a clear plan for implementing those improvements.

This is what success looks like:

After 12 months, you are a trusted partner for colleagues working with our quality systems and Change Control process. You confidently support the organization in executing changes, ensuring they are well considered, appropriately approved, and completed on time. You have improved the Change Control process to strengthen both compliance and efficiency, and have identified and implemented improvements across other areas of the QMS. You combine strong analytical thinking with a pragmatic and creative approach. You don’t just identify where something could be improved; you translate those insights into practical solutions and, when one approach doesn’t work, find alternative ways forward.


What You’ll Bring:

  • Strong analytical thinking and the ability to assess existing processes, identify where issues occur and determine how they can be improved.

  • Experience working in a regulated environment.

  • Relevant professional experience that provides an understanding of how quality systems and processes work.

  • A systematic, process-oriented way of working.

  • The ability to identify and develop solutions to quality and process problems.

  • A pragmatic and adaptable mindset, with the ability to think beyond rigid or established approaches while respecting regulatory requirements.

  • The ability to guide colleagues through processes by asking questions, highlighting considerations and ensuring required steps are completed.

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in engineering, applied sciences, biomedical engineering, or similar technical field

  • Minimum 3 to 5 years experience in Quality Assurance / Quality Systems for medical devices.

Nice to have:

  • Experience across multiple organisations or environments, providing exposure to different ways of working.

  • Medical-device experience can be relevant but is not required.

  • Experience with MDSAP

How We Work

At Vitestro, ownership is not a slogan - it is an expectation. We trust people to take responsibility, make decisions, and drive work forward.

We believe breakthroughs happen when talented people combine dedication, accountability, and teamwork. That means:

  • We take initiative rather than wait for direction.

  • We focus on execution and delivering results.

  • We proactively remove blockers and help each other succeed.

  • We challenge ideas, not people.

  • We continuously learn, improve, and raise the bar.

  • We celebrate team success over individual heroics.

We move fast, but we do so thoughtfully. We care deeply about quality because the technology we build ultimately impacts patients and healthcare professionals.

If you are looking for an environment where you can make a significant contribution, take ownership of meaningful work, and be surrounded by highly motivated colleagues, we'd love to meet you.

What we offer 

  • Competitive salary including pension plan 

  • 25 days of annual leave based on a full-time position 

  • Hybrid work model 

  • Working together in a high-skilled team with our home base in Utrecht 

  • Frequent out-of-work activities with our team, and annual company weekend away.

  • Training budget 

  • Opportunity to be key shaper of a new global industry niche: autonomous medical robotics 

We’re big fans of working from the office – this is where team spirit comes alive. At the same time, we offer flexibility, allowing up to two (out of 5) days of working from home for those who prefer it. 

Are you excited? 

We totally understand that and so are we! By joining us, you can play an active role in changing the future of health care. Excited to join our revolution? Then we’d love to hear from you! 

If you think you've got what it takes, but you don't meet all the requirements - we still recommend you apply. We would love to learn about your interest and experience and consider if you can be a good fit for Vitestro. Nobody is a perfect fit, and we welcome applications with imperfections. We offer a learning environment where we grow together!
